group.title: A hotel room change
group.passage:
Woman: My room faces the street, and the traffic noise kept me awake. Is there a quieter room available?
Man: We have a room facing the courtyard, but housekeeping will not finish preparing it until two this afternoon.
Woman: That works. I will be at a conference until five. Can I leave my luggage with you now?
Man: Of course. We can move it to the new room once the room is ready. Please collect your new key when you return.
group.passageZh:
女：我的房間面向街道，交通噪音讓我睡不著。有比較安靜的房間嗎？
男：我們有一間面向中庭的房間，但房務要到今天下午兩點才會整理好。
女：可以。我會參加會議到五點。現在能把行李寄放在你們這裡嗎？
男：當然。新房間準備好後，我們可以把行李搬過去。回來時請領取新房卡。
